about: Now in 3D – Azur Lane is now retrofitted for the PS4 as a 3D action shooter! Choose from 25+ playable and 30+ support characters, including newcomers, Shimakaze and Suruga, to help lead your fleet to victory.

4 Game Modes – Story Mode goes through 7 riveting chapters. In Extreme Battle Mode, battle against 100+ fleets for special materials. Pose characters in Photo Mode! Episode Mode includes 50+ additional sub-stories!
Arm Your Armada – Exchange blueprints to create new gear, convert materials into rare items, and earn rewards. Experiment with various fleet arrangements to gain special in-game bonuses!
Take Aim - Control, aim, and fire at will! Dash to evade attacks or activate defensive shields, unleash torpedoes or aircrafts, and switch-on character-specific special attacks!
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
